name: Riche Eden
source:
The second princess of the Kingdom of Eden. 

She’s pursuing Snake Crest, an evil organization plotting to put the world at war, all by herself. At the same time, she’s searching for a personal Knight she can trust to assist her. Childhood friends with [url=https://vndb.org/c31030]Ramius[/url].

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1061]Mangagamer[/url]]
